recipe.title: Shredded chicken
recipe.notes: This is from the "Boob to Food" website, boobtofood.com
recipe.prep: Preheat a slow cooker on low.

i.n: chicken stock cube (made up with minimal water) or stock-pot jelly

method.s: Sauté onion and garlic until softened. Add spices and salt, then cook for one minute.
Deglaze the pan with 2 Tbs of chicken stock, then add chicken thighs and brown slightly.
Stir in chopped tomatoes and 1/4 C chicken stock.
Transfer everything to slow cooker and cook on low for four hours.
Add black beans, shred the chicken with forks, and stir through the sauce before serving.
